page_sections.heading: About Z
body: Z Hostel is part of a new breed of hostels that combines a higher standard of accommodation with a fun, social atmosphere. Every detail that you find in each room was well thought of to best suit the guest. The Café gives you a taste of authentic Filipino cuisine, while the Z Roof Deck Bar offers great entertainment nightly by live artists and DJs, both local and international. It makes one wonder, how did this all come together?

The managing owners at Z Hostel are a passionate group of friends who took their time to conceptualize and build the hostel from an inspiration. This inspiration began from their Sunday Slowdown sessions at a beach resort called La Luz. There was a certain vibe that was born from music, being around like minded individuals, strangers becoming lifelong friends, and having sophisticated conversations. This was where the foundation of Z Hostel was created.

And it is this same foundation that kept Z going and open throughout the challenging times of the pandemic. We’re going back to full-swing — stronger than ever and with the same brand of good vibes and top-notch service.

page_sections.heading: What is RFID?
page_sections.subheading: Z Hostel Introduces the FIRST RFID payment system in a hostel in the Philippines
body: Radio frequency identification, or RFID, is a generic term for technologies that use radio waves to automatically identify people or objects. The most common type used is to store a serial number that identifies a person or object, and perhaps other information on a microchip that is attached to an antenna (the chip and the antenna together are called an RFID transponder or an RFID tag). The antenna enables the chip to transmit the identification information to a reader. The reader converts the radio waves reflected back from the RFID tag into digital information that can then be passed on to computers that can make use of it.

page_sections.heading: Why use RFID at Z?
body: This will facilitate cashless transactions. Transactions at the bar will be faster and there will be no need to wait for change because the exact amount will be debited. Efficiency.

page_sections.heading: Mixed Dorms
body: Our Mixed Dorm Rooms are probably the biggest and most comfortable you will ever stay in. The customized bunk beds are wide and big with your own electric socket and reading lamp. Each bed also has its own towel rack and there are hooks around the room for hanging your clothing articles. Out for a walk around the city? No need to worry! Our dorm lockers are big enough to fit your valuables and each one has its own electric socket so you could charge that GoPro for your next adventure!

page_sections.heading: Getting there
body: We are located in a prime area in Makati City. We are walking distance to the famous red light district of P. Burgos Street. We are also walking distance to numerous bars, restaurants, clubs and cafes. Getting a cab is also not a problem. Powerplant Mall in Rockwell and Century Mall are just less than a kilometer away as well.
From Ninoy Aquino International Airport, taking a taxi is the most convenient way to get to the hostel. Simply give the driver the following instructions:

Ask the driver to take you to Kalayaan Ave. in Makati via Edsa Northbound and exiting to Rockwell. Drive through Rockwell out towards Kalayaan. Along Kalayaan Ave., you will find a Mini Stop Convenience Store on your right. That street is Don Pedro Street. Make a right there. Our hostel will be on your left, just a few meters from the corner.
We recommend our guests to use the Grab or Uber app as airport taxis tend to overcharge. Rates should vary between Php 250 – 350 depending on the time of day and Manila traffic.

features.heading: Feel-good and Comfy
body: Spacious accommodation with customized big beds, each with its own electric socket and reading lamp. Our rooms offer air-conditioning, counters with kitchen sink, and en-suite bathrooms perfect for any traveler. Regular sanitation protocols are ensured for your safety. Enjoy a modern and minimal environment throughout your stay.

features.heading: Taste the Flavor
body: Hostel vibe with restaurant-quality offers and service. The Z Cafe houses the Original Z blend coffee, a buffet breakfast, and sumptuous bestsellers such as Adobo Flakes, Sisig, Beef Sinigang. New menu additions such as Yakitori and Street Ramen take your hostel dining to a whole new level. Alcoholic beverages and refreshments are always available during cafe hours.

features.heading: Party All Night!
body: Now world-renowned, the Z Roofdeck has definitely put the hostel on a sweet, top spot in the traveling industry. It features a fantastic view of the Manila skyline from every angle, a bar serving cold beers, fresh cocktails, and cracking munchies, and a DJ deck which has become home to local and international artists. Happy Hour Monday-Thursday 5-8pm. It's packed with great crowd on a weekday, on weekends it's a rooftop party.

features.heading: Explore the hood
features.subheading: Right smack in the center of a business and cultural district
body: Dotted with hole-in-the-wall restaurants, quaint coffee shops, and art spaces, Z Hostel’s neighborhood is a throbbing heartbeat in the middle of a bustling city. Join our Sunset Sessions from 6PM at the Roofdeck where one free cocktail awaits all in-house guests. Get walking and sample local and international food from many establishments around.

rooms.name: 4 Bed
description: Perfect for those who want a good mix of privacy and sociability

rooms.name: 6 Bed
description: Just the right amount of people to turn your stay into a fun experience
notes: *The 6-bed and 8-bed dorm rooms also have a built-in sink inside the room for a quick fix-up without having to wait forever for the shower room.

rooms.name: 8 Bed
description: If you're up for a party and designed for interaction without compromising comfort. They are near the elevators, too, for an easier access to the Roofdeck or the lobby for a chill-out session with your new-found friends!
notes: *The 6-bed and 8-bed dorm rooms also have a built-in sink inside the room for a quick fix-up without having to wait forever for the shower room.

rooms.name: All Female
description: Who says backpacking means always having to rough it up? Unleash the lady in you and welcome to our “Stiletto” room! Our All-Female Dorm is every girl traveller’s ideal home on the road. There’s a dresser where you can lounge around and a vanity mirror to get ready for that night out in the city! We’ve got your priceless possessions covered, too! The room’s lockers are designed to be bigger than usual mixed dorm lockers. This room is perfect for socializing with fellow female travelers and being comfortable in your skin. And if you’re a group of girls traveling together, then make this your she-shed while in Manila!
notes: *Hairdryer, flat iron and board are available upon request.

rooms.name: Private Room
description: Good vibes taken on a whole new level! Strategically located on the highest floors, our private rooms are the perfect place for comfort while staying at the hostel --- it is fully air-conditioned, features a queen size bed with two pillows and duvet, your own private bathroom en-suite, and two bathrobes. And the great part? You are just a few steps away from the world-renowned Z Roofdeck, which gives you a breathtaking view of the skyline while having some cold beers at the bar. The music beats might just get you in the groove for some drinks and socializing at night! So if you are looking for a good night’s sleep, this might not be the ideal place for you.
notes: *Hairdryer, flat iron and board are available upon request

rooms.name: Private Room Bunk Bed
description: Privacy and personal space in one — Z Hostel is spoiling you with this Private Bunk Bed Room! Now you can have a whole room for you and your buddy but you also get your own down or private time from each other. Not that being cozy is bad but you get what we mean!
notes: *Hairdryer, flat iron and board are available upon request

rooms.name: Fun Floor
description: Our social fun rooms are perfect for those who want a good mix of comfort, sociability, and fun. These rooms are situated right below our world renowned roof deck bar where we hold events almost every night. Now you have a closer access to a whole deck of fun and more reasons to make new friends! Since we operate until 3AM, the music and chitchats can be heard in these rooms so just let us know if you’re up for the fun.
published_price: PHP 3000 / Bed (2 PAX) with Free Breakfast for 2

reviews.title: Best Hostel!
reviews.text: One of the best hostels in Asia...

reviews.title: I Love Z Hostel
reviews.text: I love Z Hostel and the crowd. I always go with my friends.

reviews.title: It Was Great!
reviews.text: I spent my 3 days there in bed because I was sick. BUT EVEN LIKE THAT, IT WAS GREAT!

reviews.title: Nice hub in Manila
reviews.text: Our 4 person, mixed dorm was nice. There are spaces for all of your belongings, charging stations and nooks in your allocated bed , aircon, and a decent bathroom.

reviews.title: Best hostel I've been to in awhile!
reviews.text: I stayed in Z hostel for 3 nights and my time there wasn't anything less than fantastic. My best friend and myself stayed in a 6 bed mixed dorm room and the place was exceptionally clean. The rooms came with lockers to safely keep your valueables and towels were provided as well. Hot running water for showers throughout the day and all the staff were very helpful to us. Best of all, it was afforable and really got our value for money here.

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: The room is full of mirrors which is fantastic. Great views on the roof terrace as well! Very clean and comfortable beds and bathrooms. Big plus is beds come with personal light and 2 outlets!

activity_descriptions.label: Filipino Homecooked Dinner
activity_descriptions.text: What better way to fully experience a destination than sample local, authentic food! Set-up at the historic The Ruins, enjoy traditional Filipino dishes usually prepared in Filipino homes and enjoyed by the family. Experience “salu-salo”, the culture and celebration of eating together in the Philippines, with fellow guests and get to know them more. After all, the hostel becomes your home and your roommates family!

activity_descriptions.label: Walking Tour
activity_descriptions.text: Before you knock back some tipples and enjoy the amazing nightlife of Z Hostel’s neighborhood, get a good feel of the area with our daily walking tour around the community with a Z Hostel crew as your guide. It’s also a great way to navigate your way around Poblacion and see where you could hang out, dine, and do your errands during the rest of your stay. It starts around 4:30 every afternoon and just show up at the lobby a few minutes before.

activity_descriptions.label: Sunset Session
activity_descriptions.text: Come up our world-renowned Roofdeck around 6 in the afternoon for the daily Sunset Session. All in-house guests get one free cocktail, watch the sun go down along the Manila skyline, and make new friends. It's packed with great crowd on a weekday; on weekends it's a rooftop party!

venues.name: Fook Yah
description: Fook Yah is a concept borne out of nostalgic love for dining in Hong Kong, and want to recreate the atmosphere and cuisine of a favorite neighborhood eatery of roasts and noodles right here in Manila.

venues.name: Ebi 10
description: The newest addition to the Poblacion neighborhood, serves a wide array of authentic tempura and other Japanese favorites within the heart of Metro Manila.

venues.name: Mahalo Acai
description: A cozy little café offering the first and only tastiest Dairy-Free Almond milk based Frozen Yogurt infused with Brazilian Acai Superberry in the country.

venues.name: Alamat
description: A Filipino pub cuisine whose main inspiration for the food is tribal and ancestral Filipino dishes that attracts guests who are in search of a new experience!

venues.name: Onlypans Taqueria
description: Onlypans is an authentic taqueria situated in the heart of Poblacion. They are best known for their street tacos & Birria.

venues.name: Yalla Yalla
description: Set in a tiny quick casual diner, Yalla Yalla Express offers affordable and authentic Lebanese cuisine for a recovery treat. ”Yalla” is a common expression originally in “Arabic”, denoting “Let’s get going”. Putting a distinct style to their food, Yalla Yalla Express will surely entice you with the convenience and taste of their Lebanese offerings.

venues.name: Wantusawa
description: A casual dining restaurant in Poblacion, Makati City that highlights local seafood products, uses the freshest ingredients and focuses on Southeast Asian flavors. It serves as a stage for the magnificent Philippine oyster.

venues.name: Kampai
description: The original Kampai stood along Tambai Alley, back when Poblacion was a much quieter neighborhood. Now situated in an old house, the new izakaya is still a homey place just a lot spacier.

venues.name: OTO
description: Ranked as one of Asia’s 100 Best Bars in 2021, Oto is a one-stop shop for coffee, cocktails, and (underrated) snacks. With a Hi-Fi sound system as its piece de resistance, Oto is a hub for music and food & beverage enthusiasts alike.

venues.name: Gawad Kalinga Enchanted Farm Bulacan
description: Dubbed as the Silicon Valley of social entrepreneurship, Gawad Kalinga Enchanted Farm has become the hub for social tourism in the Philippines. From bottled lemongrass teas, organic personal care products to artisan chocolates, different products have been developed by local farmers and townsfolk under the mentorship of the farm university. The tour includes a visit to the farm’s livelihood programs as well as lunch prepared by the GK team, with food freshly sourced from the farm.

venues.name: Masungi Georeserve
description: How does lying on a giant hammock in the middle of lush greens sound to you? Or go bird-watching while standing on a giant metal spider-web suspended above rock formations? How about some rope courses and photo ops on a hanging bridge? If adventure is your middle name, this geopark tour just a few hours away from Manila is definitely for you! Masungi Georeserve is tourism with a heart --- it aims to protect the area’s jaw-dropping natural landscape and the unique flora and fauna found in it from illegal practices. Get those hiking boots on and let the adventure begin!

venues.name: Bambike Tours
description: A cultural tour with sustainability at its core: using uniquely designed and Filipino-made bamboo bikes, have a wonderful time through the historic walled city of Intramuros, Manila dotted with Spanish architectural houses and buildings, century-old churches, and historical museums. Burn the calories but gain a lot of insights about the Philippines!

venues.name: Smokey Tours - Slum tour
description: Take a deeper look into what the lesser-privileged yet resilient people of the metro endure every day, in an area called Bataan Shipping and Engineering Company Compound or more popularly known as BASECO. It’s more than just seeing but a chance to understand how they live and survive and still hope for a better tomorrow.

venues.name: Smokey Tours - Market Tour
description: Whether you’re looking for quirky, local stuff to buy as souvenirs or sample authentic cuisines, the Market Tour is a great way to do all these. Set around Old Manila, equal parts gritty and soulful, the tour takes you to the market area where all kinds of merchandise from local medicinal herbs, flowers, statues, clothing, and digital gadgets can be found. Delve into the religious aspect of the Filipino as well as you visit the Quiapo Catholic Church and the Islamic Golden Mosque. Round it up with sumptuous Chinese food at the Chinatown, touted as the oldest in the world.

venues.name: Shopping Tour
description: Nothing beats the buzz of strolling around stall-lined streets and striking up a good bargain. It’s the hunt for those eclectic treasures coupled with "I-can't-believe-I-found-this" moments that transform our local markets into an exhilarating experience. Spend a weekend excursion with Tanlines to off-the-beaten-path shopping locales around the metro that offer quirky, locally-crafted products at very affordable prices.

Dapitan is our first stop. With its pop culture decor, home furnishings, and vintage finds, roaming around the area is like stepping into another era. Next, we’ll head on over to Dampa, the city's cleanest wet market to pick fresh seafood and tropical produce to fill our tummies. Ending with a bang, the mecca of Filipino bargains—Greenhills Shopping Center—is our last stop. Pearls, electronics, local handmade crafts—you name it, they have it.
